name: Match3
author: Ben Smith
description: A match-3 puzzle with emoji faces: swap neighbouring tiles to line up three or more of a kind and rack up points.

descriptions.en: A match-3 puzzle with emoji faces: swap neighbouring tiles to line up three or more of a kind and rack up points.
descriptions.it: Un puzzle match-3 con faccine emoji: scambia le tessere vicine per allinearne tre o più uguali e accumulare punti.
